data_cutoff_policy: Each observation retains its own provider/event/period timestamp. Capture time is not substituted for a missing source timestamp.

receipt_contract.hash_scope: Hashes cover the exact API response text or exact excerpt text stored in this artifact. They do not represent original HTTP wire bytes, response headers, TLS metadata or an independent timestamp anchor.

source_registry.source_method: Daily rippled account_info reads on validated ledger; wallet attribution uses XRPSCAN public labels.

excerpts.text: As of November 7, 2026 (08:01 UTC), 22.33 billion XRP sits in 701 XRP Ledger wallets attributed to 24 exchanges — about 32.4% of XRP’s circulating supply (68.89 billion). Same-wallet change: −150.7M XRP over 7 days and −161.2M over 30 days.
The page includes cold storage and exchange omnibus wallets; 48.4% is labeled cold, 39.9% is unlabeled, and 487.8M XRP is wrapped-asset, insurance or charity reserves. It is not tradable float.

limitations: Wallet balances are attributed to exchanges, not proof of beneficial ownership or assets available for immediate sale.
Cold custody, omnibus customer balances, wrapped-asset backing and insurance/charity reserves are included.
A same-wallet decline can include transfers to wallets not yet labeled or tracked; it is not proof of customer withdrawals or buying.
Korbit main wallets are not in the tracked set; the South Korean subtotal is a floor.
The source's exchange table lists Binance non-customer reserves as 327.4M XRP, while its methodology breakdown says 325.8M; 1.6M difference unresolved.

derivatives.reconciliation: TradRadar publishes a seven-exchange OI sum; Alpha describes all-exchange aggregation but does not disclose the exact XRP venue universe. Different coverage and aggregation prevent averaging.
derivatives.interpretation: Positive funding and a 79.2% long-account share coexist with larger reported long liquidations and declining TradRadar OI. This is consistent with long-side deleveraging, but provider coverage and partial liquidation feeds prevent a directional conclusion.

reconciliation.conflict: Alpha Finance reports zero on 6 Nov across five funds; CryptoKeyhole reports −752,048 XRP across three of four funds, concentrated in XRPC.
reconciliation.upstream_lineages: Alpha Finance identifies Coinglass as its ETF feed; CryptoKeyhole says it reads each issuer's own holdings/NAV file. Pipelines differ, but both ultimately depend on issuer disclosures and are not fully independent economic evidence.
reconciliation.resolution: Unresolved. The CryptoKeyhole future-dated 9 Nov file metadata is quarantined; its 6 Nov row remains partial. No averaging or directional flow inference.
reconciliation.primary_source_gap: The official Canary XRPC page retrieved in this run showed holdings only through 19 Oct 2026, not 6 Nov. The opened CorpStacking page was stale at 4 Nov even though its search snippet suggested 6 Nov; that search snippet is excluded.

macro.context: Reuters attributes the largest six-month weekly money-market inflow to caution around US midterms and AI hyperscaler cash burn. It also reports large US equity-index declines on Thursday. This is broad risk-appetite context, not an XRP-specific catalyst.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: Positive funding, high long-account share, long liquidations dominating and declining OI are consistent with a crowded-long deleveraging phase.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: OI universes differ materially; liquidations are incomplete; account share is not notional exposure; spot timestamps are not synchronized.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: A sufficiently strong spot rebound could encounter modelled short-liquidation clusters above spot.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Clusters are modelled from OI and leverage tiers, not observed resting orders; no consolidated spot depth was captured.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: Same-wallet attributed exchange balances fell over seven and thirty days.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Cold custody, omnibus balances, wrapped reserves, unlabeled destinations and newly tracked wallets make the total unsuitable as tradable float.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: Alpha Finance reports zero ETF flow for 6 Nov and only modest positive seven/30-session flows.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: CryptoKeyhole's partial issuer-file series reports a materially different XRPC change; future-dated metadata and missing Franklin file prevent resolution.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: Large money-market inflows and equity-index losses indicate broad risk aversion that may constrain speculative-asset demand.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Macro flow is not XRP-specific and does not establish causal XRP sensitivity or future direction.

reasons: Kraken ticker lacks a provider timestamp and HTTP Date in the retrieved representation.
OKX ticker is older than the 300-second live-feature limit.
Cross-venue USD/USDT quotes are not normalized or synchronized.
Exchange wallet totals include cold, custody and wrapped-asset reserves and are not tradable float.
Derivatives aggregators have materially different OI coverage and incomplete liquidation data.
ETF providers disagree on 6 Nov; one row is partial and carries impossible future-dated file metadata.
Macro data is contextual and not a direct XRP feature without a point-in-time model specification.
